groups.label: Projects
groups.description: Which projects make or lose money, and which are at risk?

metrics.name: Active projects
metrics.definition: Projects in Active status at the end of the period.
metrics.formula: count of Active projects
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Hours on client work
metrics.definition: Hours logged in the period on projects that have a client.
metrics.formula: Σ hours on client projects

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Burning ahead of time
metrics.definition: Projects using their fee (hours at cost and direct costs, without overhead; or, without a fee, their estimate) faster than their time passes, by more than the margin set in Settings.
metrics.formula: fee (or estimate) used % > time elapsed % + margin
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Capacity
groups.description: Can we take more work, and when?

metrics.name: Capacity
metrics.definition: Working hours in the period, from the calendar (weekends, holidays and shorter days), less approved leave and permissions; counted from each person's hire date and until they were deactivated.
metrics.formula: Σ per person per working day: the day's hours − leave and permissions

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Logged hours
metrics.definition: Every hour logged in the period by the people in view.
metrics.formula: Σ hours logged

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Utilisation
metrics.definition: Standard hours (all but production-day hours) as a share of capacity, for the people with capacity in the period. Nothing logged is "No data", never a good figure.
metrics.formula: standard hours ÷ capacity

target.text: Inside 65%–80%

metrics.name: Free hours, next 8 weeks
metrics.definition: Capacity in the next eight weeks less booked work (remaining estimates on dated, assigned tasks and upcoming retainer cycles) and likely deals, floored at zero person by person and week by week.
metrics.formula: Σ weekly max(0, capacity − booked − likely)
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Over capacity
metrics.definition: People whose utilisation in the period is above the overload threshold in Settings.
metrics.formula: count of people with C3 > overload threshold

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Burnout risk
metrics.definition: People above their whole weekly capacity for at least the number of weeks running set in Settings, in weeks ending inside the period.
metrics.formula: count of people with ≥ N consecutive weeks of standard hours > weekly capacity
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Hours coming
metrics.definition: The service reference hours of deals at the forecast stage or beyond, by department, from each deal's expected start.
metrics.formula: Σ reference hours, by department and expected start
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Delivery
groups.description: Do we deliver on time, and where does work wait?

metrics.name: On-time delivery
metrics.definition: Tasks that reached Approved in the period with a due date, and were finished on or before it, as a share of all of them.
metrics.formula: on time ÷ approved with a due date

target.text: At least 85%

metrics.name: Overdue
metrics.definition: Open tasks (neither Approved nor Closed) past their due date at the end of the period.
metrics.formula: count of open tasks with due date < period end
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: At most 0 tasks

metrics.name: Cycle time
metrics.definition: Working days a task spends from its first In progress to Approved -- in In progress, In review and client review -- over the tasks approved in the period, from the trail of their statuses. A task with no trail is left out and counted.
metrics.formula: Σ working days in those statuses ÷ approved tasks with a trail

target.text: At most 14.0 days

metrics.name: Send-backs per approved task
metrics.definition: The send-backs that happened in the period -- a task moved from either review status back to In progress -- for each task approved in the period.
metrics.formula: send-backs in the period ÷ tasks approved in the period

target.text: At most 2.0 rounds

metrics.name: Waiting on the client
metrics.definition: Working days approved tasks spent in client review, over the ones that went through it.
metrics.formula: Σ working days in that status ÷ tasks that went through it

target.text: At most 2.0 days

metrics.name: Where work waits
metrics.definition: For each status, the average working days the tasks approved in the period spent in it; the figure is the longest.
metrics.formula: per status: Σ working days ÷ tasks with time in it

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Estimate accuracy
metrics.definition: Hours logged against the estimate, over the tasks approved in the period that had one. A handover's follow-up tasks count their hours with the task they continue. Within the band in Settings is on plan.
metrics.formula: Σ hours logged ÷ Σ estimated hours

target.text: Inside 90%–110%
target.where: Settings › Insights: the estimate accuracy band

metrics.name: Aging tasks
metrics.definition: Open tasks nobody has touched -- no hours, no status change, no comment -- for the number of days in Settings.
metrics.formula: count of open tasks untouched for N days
metrics.source: Tasks, time entries, comments, status history
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Team utilisation
metrics.definition: Utilisation (C3) for the people in view: standard hours as a share of capacity.
metrics.formula: standard hours ÷ capacity

target.text: Inside 65%–80%

metrics.name: Client-work share
metrics.definition: Hours on client projects as a share of all hours, over the same people as utilisation.
metrics.formula: hours on client projects ÷ all hours

target.text: Inside 55%–70%

metrics.name: Overtime
metrics.definition: Hours beyond the day's length: on production days, and on standard days over the length, person by person.
metrics.formula: Σ per person per day: max(0, production − day) + max(0, standard − day)

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Leave used
metrics.definition: Annual leave taken this year to the end of the period, as a share of the year's entitlement, beside the share of the year gone. Watch when it trails the year by more than 25 points.
metrics.formula: days taken ÷ entitlement
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: The year's entitlement, against the share of the year gone
target.where: Control panel › Leave settings: the annual entitlement

metrics.name: Internal time
metrics.definition: Personal and internal hours as a share of all hours (an internal project has no client). Totals only: personal time is never shown per person.
metrics.formula: personal and internal hours ÷ all hours

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Trust score
metrics.definition: How far the figures can be trusted, out of 100: the weighted mean of the timer share, hours logged against capacity, logging on the day, entries left as logged, and open tasks with a type and an estimate. The weights are in the configuration.
metrics.formula: 100 × Σ weight × share ÷ Σ weights

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Logged by timer
metrics.definition: Hours logged by the timer as a share of all hours.
metrics.formula: timer hours ÷ all hours

target.text: At least 80%

metrics.name: People missing hours
metrics.definition: People who logged less than the share of their capacity set in Settings.
metrics.formula: count of people with logged < share × capacity

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Logged late
metrics.definition: Entries made the number of days in Settings or more after the day they record.
metrics.formula: count of entries made ≥ N days late

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

metrics.name: Edited after logging
metrics.definition: Entries changed after they were logged.
metrics.formula: count of entries with an edit

target.text: At most 10 entries

metrics.name: Tasks missing data
metrics.definition: Open tasks with no task type, plus open tasks with no estimate: each distorts a figure (time by type, estimates, forward load).
metrics.formula: open tasks with no type + open tasks with no estimate
metrics.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
metrics.type: Stock: as at the end of the period

target.text: No target: this figure is read, not judged

groups.label: Forecast
groups.description: What revenue and work is coming? (Clients › Forecast)

metrics.name: Open pipeline
metrics.definition: The value of every open deal; coverage is the weighted pipeline of the next three months (value × chance, the deals expected to start in them) against those months' revenue target.
metrics.formula: Σ value of open deals · coverage = weighted pipeline, next 3 months ÷ revenue target, next 3 months
metrics.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

target.text: Coverage of 1.2× the next three months' revenue target

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: Deals won as a share of those won or lost, by count, closed in the period.
metrics.formula: won ÷ (won + lost)

target.text: At least 30%

metrics.name: Days to close
metrics.definition: The mean days from a deal being made to its win, for those won in the period.
metrics.formula: Σ days from creation to won ÷ deals won

target.text: At most 30.0 days
